description.zh: 查看 Excel 工作簿结构（不修改）：工作表、表头所在行、列名、数据行范围、前几行样例、合并单元格、数据验证、条件格式、常用字体；给 group_by 时列出该列相同值组成的连续段及行号。处理 .xlsx 前先用它，一次就够，不要再写代码逐项检查。
description.en: Read an Excel workbook's structure without changing it: sheets, header row, columns, data rows, a few sample rows, merged cells, validations, conditional formats, common fonts; with group_by, the contiguous blocks of equal values in that column with their rows. Use it once before working on an .xlsx instead of writing code to probe the sheet.

path.description: 工作簿路径：附件的绝对路径，或工作目录内的相对路径

group_by.description: 按哪一列分段：列名、列字母或序号，如 "县支机构"

within.description: 只看/只改某一段：该列等于该值的连续行，如 {"column": "中支机构", "value": "合肥中支"}

path.description: workbook path: an attachment's absolute path or a workspace-relative path

group_by.description: column to split into blocks: header name, letter or number

within.description: limit to one stretch: the contiguous rows where column equals value, e.g. {"column": "Region", "value": "North"}
